credentials.description: service ID — the user part of HTTP Basic auth, base64(SERVICE_ID:SECRET_TOKEN)
secret token — the password part of HTTP Basic auth
`sender_name`: an approved sender name of your account (status 'accepted'), case-sensitive

example_prompt: Add SMS sending to my app via NimbaSMS.

to.description: Recipient numbers. Three accepted formats: local (623XXXXXX), with dialing code (224623XXXXXX), or E.164 (+224623XXXXXX). Maximum 30 contacts per request.

message.description: Content of the message to send. Maximum 665 characters (5 SMS). Use the simulator https://simulator.nimbasms.com/ to calculate the cost.

sender_name.description: Approved sender name (case-sensitive). Must exactly match a sender name with status 'accepted' in your account.

messageid.description: Unique message identifier. Use with get_message to track the delivery status.

message_cost.description: Number of SMS consumed (message length in number of SMS × number of recipients).

url.description: URL to retrieve the message details (GET /v1/messages/{messageid}).

detail.description: General error (e.g. account without sending privileges, insufficient balance).

sender_name.description: Error on the sender_name field (e.g. 'Sender Name invalide.').

solde.description: Insufficient balance error (e.g. 'Le solde de votre compte est insuffisant.').

to.description: Error on the recipients (e.g. 'Aucun numéro valide fourni.').

gotchas: sender_name is case-sensitive and must exactly match a name with status 'accepted' returned by list_sendernames. 'active' is not a valid status — it is 'accepted'.
The 'to' field accepts three interchangeable formats: local (623XXXXXX), with country code (224623XXXXXX), or E.164 (+224623XXXXXX). Maximum 30 recipients per request.
The message is limited to 665 characters (5 SMS). Beyond 160 characters, message_cost increases proportionally. Use the simulator to estimate before sending.
The HTTP response is 201 Created (not 200). The response contains only messageid, message_cost and url — the full details (per-recipient status) are in GET /v1/messages/{messageid}.
400 errors return fields with string values (not arrays): sender_name, solde, to, detail. Check the balance with get_balance before a bulk send.
open_questions: Sandbox: provider.json declares none and no gotcha documents a test environment — every call reaches production.
